rationale:
`assets/skills/habeas-evidence/SKILL.md` is a bundled skill with front matter, so it is a site of `requirements.cli.skill_conventions`.

Its `description` starts with "Use when Habeas evidence needs creating or refreshing, or when `habeas coverage` or `habeas status` reports Habeas findings…". It then lists the user's situations: missing, stale or false evidence, uncovered `{test}` lines, FIXME judgments, and the user saying "the habeas test is failing". That states when to use the skill in terms of the user's task, which meets the MUST.

The description also says "If evidence went stale because code or requirements moved, use habeas-refactor first." The requirement only permits naming another skill (MAY), so this is allowed. `habeas-refactor` exists under `assets/skills`, so the reference is valid. I found no gap.
